competences: Explain roles of the President, Cabinet and ministers.
Identify civil servants and their administrative heads.
languageCompetence: Read, spell and write the key Social Studies terms used in this lesson.
objectives: State the roles of the president of Uganda.
Explain the work of the cabinet and ministers.
Explain who civil servants are and name the head of civil servants in a ministry and a district.
references: P.5 Social Studies Lesson Notes Term III: Uganda as an Independent Nation

steps.teacherActivity: Recall the components of the Executive.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners name the President, ministers and civil servants.

source.quote: This organ is made up of the president, ministers and civil servants.

steps.teacherActivity: Explain duties of the President and Cabinet.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners state responsibilities of the President and Cabinet.

steps.teacherActivity: Explain ministers and the role of ministries.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners distinguish Cabinet ministers and ministers of state.

source.quote: Ministers are appointed by the president and approved by the parliament

steps.teacherActivity: Explain civil servants and their heads; use sourced questions for assessment.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners identify Permanent Secretary, CAO and government employees.

source.quote: The head of all civil servants in the district is the Chief Administrative Officer

assessment: Assess learners with the source-written questions in the exercise and check their correct answers.
